body.statement: Dwivedi et al.'s published Theorem 3.1 and equations (17)--(18) give a high-probability squared-error bound for their nearest-neighbor estimator of one treatment-specific mean counterfactual at a fixed unit and time under their Assumptions 1--5.

source.locator: published page 2389, Theorem 3.1 and equations (17)--(18); abstract and Section 3.1 heading
source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 3.1 is headed "Non-asymptotic error bound for \(\widehat\theta_{i,t,\eta}^{(a)}\)" and begins with a sequential experiment satisfying Assumptions 1--5.  The paper describes this result as a non-asymptotic high-probability bound for the counterfactual mean for each unit and each time; equations (17)--(18) display its squared-error bound and tuning choice.

attestation.note: Verified directly against the published article text on 2026-09-08, including the theorem hypothesis, fixed unit-time estimator, high-probability form, and the two displayed equations.
